state.claim: The classifier works equally well in every language.

candidates.text: Work on the classifier began in January.
Language identifiers were saved as strings.
The classifier was trained using a GPU.
We acknowledge the language annotation team.
English test accuracy reached 92%; Spanish reached 61%. No other languages were evaluated.
The classifier is intended for use in every language.
We discuss what works equally well means for a classifier in every language.
Every language has its own classifier vocabulary.
The classifier interface lets users select a language.
